description:

additional_info.body:
Hi colleagues,
As far as I know, it’s a Gen2 360kW charger. Those should have power blocks of 40kW each right, so 9?
@Berger, Lukas (SI E CS SD ES)
I’m looping you in because we looked into this before. Could it be there’s nothing wrong with the converters, just with the charger thinking it should find more?
Thomas

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0399662-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / S7 170003820]-ELMS CRM:01282000762
additional_info.body:
Hi Thomas,
yes you are totally right Charger has just 9 Converters.
I adjusted that in the Config again, because somebody played around here.
I also set the Input power Limitation to 400KW so the Charger will be able to deliver 360KW if asked even with the loses.
The Powerlimitation can be now fully controlled with ELMS.
To let you know there is still a limitation on the both Outlets to 180KW. Don´t know why it is configured like this, but I would suggest to also remove that limitation so that a single user can use the full Power if needed. Just let us know and we can also change that.
There is also another ongoing Ticket (0387064) with this Charger. We defined here already that the RC-NL has to do some onside work here.
That is why the Charger is currently not working.
With kind regards,
